title: Count Odd and Even Elements in Array

content.problemStatement: Write a program to accept the array and count the number of odd and even numbers in the given array
content.inputFormat: Number of elements followed by array as an input
content.outputFormat: Display the number of Odd and Even numbers in the given array

solution.approach: Linear array traversal and transformation for array problem 146.

code.Python3:
import sys

def solve(inp):
    tokens = inp.strip().split()
    if not tokens: return ''
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n + 1]]
    odd = sum(1 for x in nums if x % 2 != 0)
    even = sum(1 for x in nums if x % 2 == 0)
    return f"Odd = {odd}\nEven = {even}"


def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read()
    if s.strip():
        print(solve(s))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
